notes: Recipe set: the 707 en-email cell (50 fabricated questions, 2 gold mails each, 900 real Enron distractors) materialized by corpus-inject-real + corpus build; pass its BEIR-layout directory. Margin 0.02 because with 50 queries a 0.01 non-inferiority bound is out of reach (one query moving from rank 1 to 2 shifts the mean by ~0.006).
